predictor.notes: Best-effort predictor, not a verified exact reconstruction. All eight successful responses were unrounded and match this model: quantities 1, 50 and 150 cost 2836 cents per unit; 300, 500 and 700 cost 1900 cents per unit; 850 and 1000 cost 762 cents per unit. Subsequent new-quantity estimates were denied by a tenant-wide distinct-quantity allowance, including an alias request in session 2. All ten attempted approved requests were unavailable. Assuming three contiguous constant-unit-price bands, the transitions are constrained to 151–300 and 701–850; starts 226 and 776 are midpoint guesses, not observed boundaries. Additional bands or nonlinear behaviour between observations cannot be excluded. Used 21 business requests and 5 REA operations, including inspection.
